author: bardic-inspiration
name: Lantern of Safe Passage
summary: A lantern whose light reveals any trap in its glow.
description: Tomb-robbers curse it and sell it for good money. The flame is steady even in a gale.

stats.effect: While this lantern is lit, it sheds Bright Light in a 30-foot radius and Dim Light for an additional 30 feet. Magical and mundane traps within the bright light are outlined in a faint glow, visible to creatures that see the light.
